title: F/CTL ALTN LAW

actions.say: Flight controls are in alternate law. Flight envelope protections are lost; handle the aircraft smoothly.
Maximum speed and manoeuvring, respect the limits. No high-speed or high-angle-of-attack protection.
Pitch trim may be manual. Use the trim wheel as required.

status: Status. Alternate law: protections lost, and normal law will not be recovered in flight.
For approach, keep the speedbrake use moderate and expect a firmer, direct-law feel in the flare.
Plan a flap full landing and add the Q.R.H. approach speed correction; ground spoilers and autobrake remain available.
